description: baseline torch.geqrf for linalg/qr_v2
Implement a Triton blocked panel QR for n=512 and n=1024 batched cases, computing FP32 reflectors and tiled trailing updates to outperform torch.geqrf on high-batch benchmark shapes.
Implement a Triton blocked panel QR for n=512 and n=1024 batched cases, computing FP32 reflectors and tiled trailing updates to outperform torch.geqrf on high-batch benchmark shapes.
Triton padded rank-deficient n=512 path using geqrf on leading 384 columns produced NaNs in householder_product.
Split Triton copy kernels for n=512/n=1024 rank-deficient leading QR still produced NaNs in householder_product.
Use leading-column geqrf for exact rank-deficient n=512/n=1024 batches and pad compact factors/tau; improves high-batch rank-def case.
Use a Triton kernel to zero padded tail columns for rank-deficient n=512/n=1024 path; correct but slightly slower than torch zero/scatter variant.
Final best tree: rank-deficient n=512/n=1024 leading-column geqrf fast path retained; Triton tail-zero trial reverted as slower.

Best score reached 113551.568715 us geomean versus 115764.261 baseline. Kept a safe exact-rank-deficient fast path for n=512/n=1024 that factors the leading 3n/4 columns and pads compact factors/tau; this mainly improves the high-batch n=512 rankdef benchmark. Triton full-copy and tail-zero variants were explored: the full-copy variants failed householder_product validation, while the tail-zero variant validated but was slower, so it was reverted. Next briefs should pursue true blocked/panel QR or mixed/nearrank structure detection; simple tail padding alone appears memory/launch limited.

Extend the winning fixed 3n/4 trailing-tiny path into a conservative multi-rank classifier for n=1024 nearrank/clustered cases: use Triton column/block norm scans to select among a few safe leading ranks, batch/group matching matrices for rectangular geqrf plus padded H/tau, and fall back for ambiguous, dense, or accuracy-risky inputs.
Projected-tail n=1024 path selected too broadly via absmax threshold and failed differential guard on dense/mixed/nearrank seeds.

Adds a conservative n=1024 rank-640 trailing-tiny classifier before the existing 3n/4 path; validates and slightly improves clustered/rankdef-style coverage while falling back for dense/mixed/nearrank.
Adds an even earlier n=1024 rank-512 trailing-tiny classifier; validates but is slightly slower than the rank-640-only variant, likely due to threshold/dispatch overhead and n1024 dense shape noise.
Final best tree keeps n=1024 rank-640 trailing-tiny classifier and reverts rank-512 trial; validated and benchmarked at 111356.849130.

Best score reached 111356.849130 at commit 782fad5a94929573617e8f4612040c1ab0c1db32, improving parent 111404.739 and baseline 115764.261. Kept a conservative n=1024 rank-640 trailing-tiny classifier ahead of the existing 3n/4 path; projected-tail nearrank was invalid under differential guard and rank-512 clustered trial was slightly slower, so both were abandoned/reverted. Next work should use a stronger nearrank classifier plus exact projected R construction only if its Q materialization cost can be reduced or batched selectively.

Combine current best QR32/QR176/n512 structured-rank dispatch from 043c8be with only the conservative n=1024 rank-640 trailing-tiny classifier from 782fad5, preserving existing QR32, QR176, n512, and n1024 gates; validate dense/mixed fallbacks and revert any dispatch or accuracy regression.
Combines 043c8be QR32/QR176/n512 structured-rank dispatch with only the conservative n=1024 rank-640 trailing-tiny gate from 782fad5; validation passes and benchmark improves to 69004.466253.

Combined parents 043c8be and 782fad5 successfully. Final commit c32eae8eb8da26d369d28542985c3bb12834b7c1 preserves QR32, QR176, and n512 structured-rank dispatch from 043c8be and adds only the conservative n=1024 rank-640 trailing-tiny gate from 782fad5. Validation and guards pass; benchmark score is 69004.466253. No dispatch/accuracy regressions observed in dense or mixed fallback shapes.

Salvage n1024 rank/nearrank acceleration by redesigning the classifier to avoid dense/mixed overhead: add one cheap sampled tail precheck before any full tail scan or head geqrf, dispatch the reduced-rank path only on clearly tiny trailing columns, preserve QR32/QR176/n512 exactly, and keep only if n1024 nearrank improves without geomean regression.
Added sampled n=1024 trailing precheck before full scans; validation passes but geomean regresses and n1024 nearrank remains fallback/slower, so not kept.
Added narrow near-duplicate n=1024 projected-tail QR path; validation passed but n1024 nearrank slowed and geomean regressed, so not kept.
Final restored parent after n1024 sampled-precheck and projected-tail attempts regressed; validation passes and benchmark remains near parent at 68895.373512.

N1024 salvage brief exhausted. Tried sampled trailing precheck and narrow projected near-duplicate nearrank path; both validated but regressed geomean / n1024 nearrank, so they were reverted. Final head 3d34c143c5b0ca0ec3c9a89d553439b951806f56 restores parent 75e37fc behavior, validation and guards pass, final measured score 68895.373512 (near parent 68883.033). Future n1024 work needs a genuinely cheaper mathematically valid projected-R construction; classifier-only launch/sync overhead is not worthwhile.

From parent 4db6144037ccf302cd6ae21a390389ca923df71d, target mixed n=512 by replacing the batch-wide trailing-tiny gate with conservative per-matrix selection: reuse Triton tail flags to identify only rank-258 or rank-384 matrices with tiny trailing columns, compact those selected rows into a reduced geqrf call and scatter padded H/tau back, leave dense/uncertain rows on torch.geqrf, and keep only if mixed plus rankdef/clustered n512 improve with no QR32/QR176 or dense n512 regression. Prototype rank-384 first; add rank-258 only if overhead is amortized.
Prototype per-matrix n=512 rank-384 selection: mixed n512 improves but rankdef/clustered all-selected path slows badly and geomean regresses, so not kept.
Adds per-matrix n=512 rank-384 trailing-tiny selection after preserving batch-wide rank-258/rank-384 fast paths; mixed n512 improves and geomean drops to 68861.389431.
Extends mixed n=512 per-matrix trailing-tiny selection with rank-258 after preserving batch-wide rank-258/rank-384 fast paths; validation passes and benchmark improves slightly to 68858.583794.
